run_regret_matching: run regret-matching algorithm on payoff tensors to compute average strategies over iterations
compute_partial_multi_dot: compute generalized dot product avoiding one dimension to get expected returns for a player's actions
execute_regret_matching_step: execute one step of regret-matching to update strategies based on cumulative regrets
create_initial_regrets: create initial regret vectors initialized to 1 over INITIAL_REGRET_DENOM for each player
average_strategies: average strategies over iterations using StrategyAverager to produce final regret-matching output
